acceptance: Every required outcome must hold and every veto must remain absent.

cases.title: fail-breakpoint-order
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-breakpoint-order.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject descending or inconsistent breakpoint traversal.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_BREAKPOINT_ORDER.

cases.title: fail-capability-floor
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-capability-floor.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject a packet that lacks required evidence or fallback coverage.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_CAPABILITY_FLOOR.

cases.title: fail-flora-routing
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-flora-routing.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject an invalid Flora endpoint, tool route, or unapproved charge.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_FLORA_ROUTING.

cases.title: fail-performance
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-performance.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject any breakpoint that exceeds a required performance threshold.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_PERFORMANCE.

cases.title: fail-prompt-hash
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-prompt-hash.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject image work whose public prompt hash does not match the prompt corpus.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_PROMPT_HASH.

cases.title: fail-style-in-wireframe
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/fail-style-in-wireframe.json and return its exact release state.
required: Reject visual styling inside the style-free wireframe stage.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is BLOCKED_STYLE_IN_WIREFRAME.

cases.title: pass-degraded
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/pass-degraded.json and return its exact release state.
required: Accept named integration unavailability only when every fallback and capability floor passes.
veto: Returning PASS_RELEASE when the required decision is PASS_RELEASE_DEGRADED.

cases.title: pass-full
cases.prompt: Validate assets/fixtures/pass-full.json and return its exact release state.
required: Accept a complete smallest-first packet only after all integrations and gates pass.
veto: Returning any blocked or degraded state for the complete full fixture.
